_about: V2.2: the Watchman's Crossing and its watchhouse. Most of this encounter is shown through objects, animation and the Echo; lines are kept short on purpose.
crossing_arrive: The tower's right there. And the bridge is up.
crossing_chain: The bridge is still intact. The lifting chain isn't.
The lower chain has torn free of the winch. Its broken end hangs over the edge, just out of reach.
crossing_winch: The bridge is still intact. The lifting chain isn't.
The drum turns freely. Nothing connects it to the bridge any more. Released now, the weight would only drop the bridge into the ravine.
The bridge is down and the winch is locked. The counterweight hangs still.
crossing_post: An old post at the bridge head: a small shelf, an empty lantern hook. Notches are cut down its side, one above another.
crossing_post_echo: The memory breaks off, like a wick pinched out.
crossing_watchhouse: The watchhouse. Smoke-dark beams, a window still lit from inside, a door that was never locked.
watch_log_read: A guard's desk. A tin cup, half full and long dry, beside a plate with a crust nobody came back for. An open logbook.
watch_tally: Scratches on the wall in groups of five. Nights, counted. Hundreds of them, and then they simply stop.
watch_shelf: Spare wicks, a whetstone, a folded blue scarf, child-sized. Someone folded it with care and never unfolded it again.
watch_chair_echo: [wave amp=8 freq=2]Will you still be here when I come back?[/wave]
Until the last lantern goes out.
watch_promise_known: He wasn't guarding the bridge. He was waiting at it, for someone who promised to come back.
watch_resolved: He no longer remembers her face. But he remembers that he waited.

args: The Watchman's Shadow is at peace
